LEMERITE.NS.d: Le Merite Exports Ltd. manufactures and trades textile products such as cotton yarn and grey and finished fabric, selling both in India and overseas. It started in 2003 and operates from Mumbai.

MANAKSTEEL.NS.d: Manaksia Steels Limited manufactures and sells secondary steel products primarily for housing, industry, and infrastructure sectors in India and internationally. The company offers cold rolled sheets used in interior and exterior panels of automobiles, buses, and commercial vehicles; galvanized corrugated sheets for use in the rural housing sector and factory buildings; and galvanized plain sheets used in the manufacture of containers and water tanks.

METROPOLIS.NS.d: Metropolis Healthcare Limited provides pathology and diagnostic laboratory services in India and internationally. The company offers clinical laboratory testing, and profiles and support services to patients, smaller labs, nursing homes, and hospitals. It provides diagnostic services for oncology, neurology, gynecology, and nephrology, as well as various health check-up packages for men, women, senior citizens, and youth and corporates.

MINDAIND.NS.d: Minda Industries Limited, together with its subsidiaries, designs, develops, manufactures, and sells auto components in India and internationally. It provides auto electrical parts, including switches, horns, and lighting products.

MUKANDLTD.NS.d: Mukand Limited manufactures and sells alloy and stainless steel products in India and internationally. It operates through Steel, Industrial Machinery and Engineering Contracts, and Others segments. The Steel segment offers billets, blooms, rounds, wire rods, bars, rods and sections, bright bars, and wires of special and alloy steel and stainless steel.

NESTLEIND.NS.d: Nestlé India Limited manufactures and sells food products in India. It provides milk products and nutrition, including dairy whitener, condensed and UHT milk, yoghurt, maternal and infant formula, baby food, and health care nutrition products; prepared dishes and cooking aids, such as noodles, sauces, seasonings, pasta, and cereals; powdered and liquid beverages comprising instant coffee and tea, and ready to drink beverages; and confectionery products consisting of bar countlines, tablets, and sugar confectionery…

ORIENTPPR.NS.d: Orient Paper & Industries Limited manufactures and sells pulp and paper products in India. The company provides chemicals; and writing, printing, industrial, specialty, and soft tissue papers. It also exports its products to Africa, the Middle East, Bangladesh, Sri Lanka, and Nepal. The company was incorporated in 1939 and is based in Kolkata, India.

ORIRAIL.NS.d: Oriental Rail Infrastructure Limited is an Indian company engaged in the manufacturing of railway components and infrastructure development. The company provides products and services for railway electrification, signaling, and track construction. Oriental Rail Infrastructure Limited is based in Mumbai, India.

PGHH.NS.d: Procter & Gamble Hygiene and Health Care Limited manufactures and sells branded packaged fast-moving consumer goods in the femcare and healthcare businesses in India. It provides health care products, including ointments and creams, cough drops, and tablets; and hygiene products comprising feminine hygiene and other skin care hygiene products. The company offers its products under the Vicks, Whisper, and Old Spice brand names.

PIONRINV.NS.d: Pioneer Investcorp Limited is a company listed on the National Stock Exchange of India under the ticker PIONRINV and traded in INR. Its country is India.

PUNJABCHEM.NS.d: Punjab Chemicals and Crop Protection Limited manufactures and sells agrochemicals and specialty chemicals, and bulk drugs and its intermediates in India, Europe, Japan, and internationally. The company provides agrochemicals, such as herbicides, insecticides, and fungicides; pharmaceutical products, including APIs, intermediates, anti-oxidants, and intermediates for APIs; fine and specialty chemicals; basic and industrial chemicals; and phosphorus derivatives and phosphates.

RETAIL.NS.d: JHS Svendgaard Retail Ventures Limited is a company listed on the National Stock Exchange of India under the ticker RETAIL and traded in INR. Its country is India.

RVHL.NS.d: Ravinder Heights Limited engages in the real estate business in India. It is involved in the acquisition, construction, and development of townships, built-up infrastructure, housing, commercial premises, hotels, resorts, hospitals, educational institutions, recreational facilities, and city and regional level infrastructure. The company was incorporated in 2019 and is based in New Delhi, India. Ravinder Heights Limited is a subsidiary of Panacea Biotec Limited.

SAMBHAAV.NS.d: Sambhaav Media Limited engages in the publishing of newspapers, magazines, and audio video media in India. The company offers Sambhaav Metro, an afternoon-daily; Abhiyyan, a Gujarati magazine; and VTVGujarati, a digital publication of news and entertainment. It also operates VTV News, a Gujarati news channel; Wise TV, an in-transit TV channel; and 13 stations, including FM radio stations in Jammu & Kashmir, as well as implements integrated vehicle tracking and passenger information systems for buses.

SANGANI.NS.d: Sangani Hospital Ltd. provides healthcare services. It operates a multi-specialty hospital with primary, secondary and tertiary care facilities. The company was founded in 2001 and is headquartered in Junagadh, India.

SARLAPOLY.NS.d: Sarla Performance Fibers Limited manufactures and sells yarns in India, the United States, and internationally. The company operates through two segments, Manufacturing of Yarn and Generation of Wind Power. It offers textured polyester, textured nylon stretch, high bulk textured polyester, high tenacity, covered, and dyed yarns, as well as textured sewing and specialty sewing threads. The company also owns 14.75 MW of windmills in Maharashtra, Gujarat, and Madhya Pradesh.

SGMART.NS.d: SG Mart Limited, set up in 1985, with its head office in Noida, trades and processes building materials for domestic and international customers. Its downstream steel products include TMT bars, angles, channels, mesh and binding wires, welding wires, hot rolled coils and steel billets.

SHIVAMAUTO.NS.d: Shivam Autotech Limited manufactures and sells auto transmission components primarily for original equipment manufacturers in India and internationally. It offers transmission gears and shafts; spline shafts; plungers; and power train, alternator, starter motor, magneto, and steering components, as well as various precision engineering components. The company was founded in 1999 and is headquartered in Gurugram, India. Shivam Autotech Limited is a subsidiary of Dayanand Munjal Investments Private Limited.

SIL.NS.d: Standard Industries Limited trades in textiles and chemical products primarily in India. It trades in cotton towels, bed sheets, interlining fabrics, cotton and blended dhotis, and cotton/PC blended and poly viscose suiting products; and cotton, PC poplins and shirting products, as well as ready to stitch PC blended and Punjabi suits. Standard Industries Limited also engages in the property business; and manufactures common salt.

SUBROS.NS.d: Subros Limited manufactures and sells thermal products for automotive applications in India. The company offers compressors; automotive condensers; heating, ventilating, and air conditioning (AC) systems, such as heaters, evaporators, and blower units; tubes and hoses; bus ACs; driver cabin ACs for railway engines; commercial and residential ACs; water dispensers; transport refrigeration systems; truck cabin AC systems; and off-roader AC systems. It also exports its products.

SUNLOC.NS.d: Sunil Healthcare Limited is involved in the pharmaceutical industry. The company manufactures and markets pharmaceutical products. Sunil Healthcare Limited is based in India.

SURAJLTD.NS.d: Suraj Limited, established in Ahmedabad in 1960, makes and supplies stainless steel seamless products, selling in India and exporting to about 70 countries. Its range includes flanges, fittings, pipes and tubes, including U-tubes, seamless instrumentation tubes and heat exchanger tubes.

SUZLON.NS.d: Suzlon Energy Limited, together with its subsidiaries, manufactures and sells wind turbine generators and related components in India, the United States, Australia, Spain, South Africa, and Turkey. The company also engages in selling solar systems; and the provision of services, such as operation and maintenance of wind turbine generators, as well as project execution and site infrastructure development services.

TARMAT.NS.d: Tarmat Limited operates as an infrastructure company in India. It undertakes various construction works, including airport runway, highways, and railways; and develops infrastructure projects, such as ports, industrial area developments, refineries, etc. The company also develops real estate properties. The company was formerly known as Roman Tarmat Limited and changed its name to Tarmat Limited in September 2012. Tarmat Limited was founded in 1986 and is headquartered in Mumbai, India.

TCIEXP.NS.d: TCI Express Limited provides express delivery solutions in India and internationally. The company provides services, including surface express; reverse express; domestic and international air express; and e-commerce express for the automotive, pharmaceutical, retail, engineering, apparel, e-commerce, and other industries. It has approximately 40,000 pickup and delivery points with approximately 5,000 containerized vehicles. The company was formerly known as TCI Properties (Pune) Limited.

TIDEWATER.NS.d: Tide Water Oil Co. (India) Limited manufactures and markets lubricants under the Veedol brand in India and internationally. It offers engine oils for trucks, tractors, commercial vehicles, passenger cars, and two/three wheelers, as well as gear oils, transmission oils, coolants, and greases for automobiles; industrial oils and greases; specialty products, such as metal working fluids, quenching oils, and heat transfer oils for industrial applications; and genuine oils.

UMA.NS.d: Uma Converter Ltd. is an Indian manufacturer and exporter of flexible packaging materials, specializing in a wide range of packaging solutions. The company's primary products include multi-color laminated rolls, various types of pouches such as vacuum, zipper, stand-up, and spout pouches, as well as multi-layer films including LD/LLDPE and stretch films.

VAML.NS.d: Vedanta Aluminium Metal Limited, incorporated in 2023 and based in New Delhi, produces metallurgical grade alumina and aluminium goods under the VEDANTAL brand, including ingots, billets, slabs, wire rods and foundry alloys. It also runs an independent power plant of 3015 megawatts. Its products serve aerospace, defence, transportation, packaging and power distribution.

VINEETLAB.NS.d: Vineet Laboratories Limited researches, develops, makes and sells active pharmaceutical ingredients, intermediates and fine chemicals, mainly in India. Its intermediates relate to drugs such as Lopinavir, Ritonavir, Efavirenz, Nadolol, Glimepiride and Celecoxib, and it also supplies reagents and fine chemicals, n-butyl lithium among them.

VISHNU.NS.d: Vishnu Chemicals Limited manufactures and markets chromium chemicals in India. The company offers chrome chemicals, such as sodium dichromate, chromic acid, chrome oxide green, basic chromium sulphate, sodium sulphate, and potassium dichromate, as well as barium carbonate. It also provides custom synthesis, contract research, and contract manufacturing services.

VTL.NS.d: Vardhman Textiles Limited, together with its subsidiaries, manufactures and sells textiles and fibre in India, the United States, Europe, rest of Asia, and internationally. The company manufactures yarns, fabrics, fibers, threads, and garments.
